snippet.title: No Blink Allowed Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4244180?utm_source=Youtube_Trailer

Try it out on Itch.io: https://itchy31.itch.io/no-blink-allowed-prologue

Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.
